meta.source: Computed locally by this repo: crates/strategy/src/preflop (see docs/PREFLOP.md)
meta.method: Discounted CFR (3000 iterations) over an abstract 6-max 100bb preflop game with 5% rake capped at 3bb; flop values = equity x realization, realization calibrated 3 times against postflop-solver (10, 10 and 16 flops per spot) and neighbour-smoothed
